name: std::basic_filebuf<CharT,Traits>::~basic_filebuf
intro: Calls close() to close the associated file and destructs all other members of basic_filebuf. If an exception occurs during the destruction of the object, including the call to close(), it is caught and not rethrown.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: Typically called by the destructor of std::basic_fstream.

examples.title: Practical use case
examples.input: Write and read a temporary file, then remove it. Public streambuf operations dispatch to filebuf's protected overflow, uflow, pbackfail, imbue, and sync functions.
